lines.zh: : {i}你是这么说,可她对你进行了至少二十分钟的性行为,毫无成果,而我一碰你的 penis 它就爆了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}If that was just a coincidence, it was certainly an improbable one. {/i}
lines.zh: : {i}如果那只是巧合,那也是个相当离谱的巧合。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}This just means additional tests are in order, though. And that I will bestow my knowledge unto Chinami the same way Ami bestowed hers unto me.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不过,这只意味着还需要追加实验。也意味着,我会把我的知识传授给 Chinami,就像 Ami 把她的传授给我一样。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Again, let’s just focus on the two of us for now.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}再说一遍,我们现在先只关注我们两个人。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}We’ve crossed a line we can’t come back from. But I don’t want it getting to your head. {/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我们已经越过了一道回不去的界线。但我不想让你因此得意忘形。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And despite what your mother is making you do, sending things like to me is not okay, Tsukasa. It’s dangerous for a number of reasons.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}而且,不管你母亲让你做什么,给我发这种东西都是不行的,Tsukasa。出于好几个原因,这很危险。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}That’s what I informed Mother as I’ve done extensive legal research on relationships like ours. But she just kept saying she could get you out of trouble if anything bad happened.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我也是这么告诉母亲的,因为我就我们这种关系做过大量的法律研究。但她只是一直说,就算出了什么坏事,她也能把你捞出来。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I imagine it will be a lot harder for her to do that with such a statement on record.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我猜,有了这样一句话留在记录里,她再做那种事就要难多了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Worst case scenario, I’ve been watching the news lately and I keep hearing talks about an island that may be of some interest to you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}最坏的情况下——我最近一直在看新闻,总听到一座岛的传闻,它也许会让你感兴趣。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Should I reach out and ask for an invitation?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}要我去联系一下,讨一份邀请吗?{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Jeeves?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Jeeves?{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Hello?{/i}
